text: Power installations above 1 kV shall comply with IEC 61936-1, low-voltage installations with IEC 60364, short-circuit calculations with IEC 60909, the GIS with IEC 62271-203, generators with IEC 60034-1, generator circuit breakers with IEC/IEEE 62271-37-013, transformers with IEC 60076 and communications with IEC 61850.
